text: {"memo": "NVDA research note, as of March 31, 2025. In fiscal year ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported revenue of $130.5 billion, up 62% from $106.9 billion in fiscal year 2024. Net income was $72.0 billion in fiscal 2025, up sharply from $34.1 billion in fiscal 2024, and diluted EPS was $4.03 versus $2.00 a year earlier. Revenue and profit had been accelerating for years: fiscal 2024 revenue was $106.9 billion, up 126% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2023, while fiscal 2023 net income was $12.4 billion, up from $4.97 billion in fiscal 2022. Margins remained elite, with fiscal 2025 operating margin around 65% and net margin above 50%, though gross margin pressure was noted as the mix shifted further to data center. Cash flow was robust, with operating cash flow around $46.5 billion in fiscal 2025. The fiscal year label matters: the latest annual figures belong to fiscal 2025, the prior year to fiscal 2024, and the prior year to fiscal 2023. The business has grown from a gaming supplier into the dominant AI infrastructure platform. View: NVIDIA shares appear richly valued after the FY2025 ramp, but the fundamental momentum remains among the strongest in semiconductors."}
